_comment: TDM-23 labelled fixture: a synthetic 10-trial baseline (NOT real robot data). 3 successes; 7 failures in 3 known modes. expected = the ground-truth grouping the test checks against.

ticket.task_description: Pick up the red cup from the table and place it on the coaster.

trials.failure_note: Gripper closed on the cup rim, cup slid out of the fingers as the arm lifted and dropped back onto the table upright.
Arm came down about 4 cm to the left of the cup and closed on air. Kept hovering next to the cup until timeout.
Picked the cup but it slipped during lift, fell back on the table still standing.
Robot never moved from home pose. Policy output ~zero actions for the whole trial.
Grasp missed: fingers closed beside the cup (left side), cup untouched.
Weak grip - cup slipped out mid-lift, landed upright near the coaster.
Missed the cup to the left again, closed on nothing (not recorded).
